title: pvVASPAnimationReader
body:
## pvVASPAnimationReader

Reads a VASP molecular-dynamics animation file (NPT_Z_ANIMATE.out) into a time-varying vtkMolecule, one frame of atom positions per time step. Use it to animate or analyse trajectories from VASP runs; pvVASPTessellationReader reads the matching Voronoi tessellation file. vtkMolecule output needs pvMoleculeToLines before ordinary dataset filters.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ParaView registers the generic .out extension for this reader; make sure the file really is an NPT_Z_ANIMATE.out file.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `VASPAnimationReader`. Identity: `sources/VASPAnimationReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | The name of the file to load. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvVASPAnimationReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
